documents: Folio's README.md, SPEC.md, DESIGN.md, CHANGELOG.md and VERSIONING.md (about 132,000 words)
judged: Each question's first evidence was written with the question. The rest were added after reading the first passage each search way put first, where it answered the question in other words (pooled judgments).
